$comment: Copy to .peer-review.json in your repo's ROOT and edit. Every field is optional; delete what you don't need. No config at all = generic safe defaults (everything unknown is high-stakes). Format is JSON, not YAML. Full field docs: ai-peer-review.schema.json.
_email_from_comment: Verified Resend sender for escalation emails. REQUIRED for email to work: it must be an address on a domain verified in your Resend account. Without it, the default sender can't deliver and emails fall back to a PR comment.
